summary.text: Mando Martinez is a Democratic state representative from Texas House District 39 who has represented the district since 2005 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Mando Martinez earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Texas-Pan American in Edinburg in 1998.
He is a licensed paramedic and firefighter with the City of Weslaco Fire Department EMS, and his professional experience includes working as a critical care flight paramedic for Valley Aircare.
Martinez's committee assignments in the 2021-2022 legislative session were Culture, Recreation, & Tourism and Transportation.
In the 2019-2020 session he was vice chair of the Culture, Recreation, & Tourism Committee.
